name: build a token vocabulary from a plain-text corpus with frequency filtering
definition: Construct a word index from the training text, applying frequency thresholds so the vocabulary is large enough and retains all 25 specifically listed terms.
failure_mode: Over-aggressive filtering or a small corpus cut drops required terms or yields too few tokens.

name: compute the exact optimum of a weighted max-sat instance
definition: Obtain the true maximum total weight of satisfiable clauses (accounting for unsatisfiable hard constraints) for a large instance.
failure_mode: Use of a non-optimizing/heuristic method or an installation producing a suboptimal value fails the exact-match check.

name: configure lora hyperparameters and target modules for a causal model
definition: Set LoRA rank, alpha, target modules, and a causal LM task so the saved adapter config carries the prescribed fields.
failure_mode: wrong target modules, rank, alpha, or missing base/task fields fail config checks

name: constrain nucleotide composition within every sliding window
definition: Keep the fraction of two of the four bases within a stated percentage range across all contiguous windows of a fixed length.
failure_mode: Any window out of range fails the scan.
